provenance.sha256_of: canonical JSON (sorted keys, compact separators, UTF-8) of the 'payload' object
notes: Data: USGS Earthquake Hazards Program, ComCat via FDSN event web service. Public domain.
summary: the FDSN query response, unmodified.

histories: per event, the origin-product versions (current and superseded) from the detail document fetched with includesuperseded=true, reduced to source, code, status, updateTime, preferredWeight, magnitude, magnitude type, origin time, location, depth, review status. The full detail bodies are not stored; their SHA-256 is listed in raw_responses.
20 of 20 events have an origin-product history; for events without one the scenario uses the summary 'time' and 'updated' fields only (see the scenario provenance).
Superseded product versions reflect what ComCat retains today; versions deleted from ComCat before the fetch are not visible here.
